name: Smart Home PRO
merging: This release will become the downloadable plugin. Check physical device operation and account authorization before publishing.

steps: Build an installable zip and validate its contents
Smoke-test the zip against a simulated Ulanzi Studio on Windows and macOS
Measure CPU and memory with simulated providers; real accounts and hardware are manual
done: Quality, coverage, SDK, secret scanning and dependency checks passed
The packaged plugin passed smoke checks against a fake Ulanzi Studio (not a real D200)

notes.install: Download `{zip}`, not GitHub's source archive; follow the [development and setup instructions]({blob}/docs/DEVELOPMENT.md).
notes.about: Home Assistant, SmartThings and Tuya integrations require provider-specific authorization. Simulated CI tests do not prove real-device interoperability. The project is independent of Ulanzi and provider vendors.
notes.checks: Automated tests and simulated host checks cover only the supported test cases. They do not test real accounts or hardware.
notes.measuredAgainst: a simulated Ulanzi host and mocked provider responses
